title: Walmart teams up with Meta to bring Black Friday deals to AI agent Muse
lede: Walmart has opened its Black Friday deals to Meta's Muse agent, so shoppers can search, compare and buy from Walmart by asking the assistant, while Amazon keeps outside agents out.

points: Users link a Walmart account in the Muse app; Muse passes requests to Walmart, which returns products and builds the cart.
Walmart says Muse gets no access to a customer's Walmart purchase history or other personal data.
Shoppers can set spending limits, require approval before purchases, review agent orders and delete the agent's profile.
It runs on Walmart's Agent Gateway, launched in October, which Walmart plans to open to more developers and AI platforms.
Instacart has also partnered with Muse, and Walmart keeps adding features to its own assistant, Sparky.

sections.text: Agent Gateway is a retailer-run interface for outside agents with spend limits and approvals built in. If it opens to more developers, it becomes a real route for third-party shopping agents to complete purchases.
